Analysis of PCs

require(magrittr)
require(tidyverse)
tx2geneFile <- "/Users/thomascarroll/Downloads/rroy/DR11.tx2gene.txt"
countDir <- "/Users/thomascarroll/Downloads/rroy/workflow_data/"
files <- dir(countDir,
             recursive = TRUE,
             pattern="quant.sf",
             full.names = TRUE)
countDir <- "/Users/thomascarroll/Downloads/rroy2/DR_Cuts/"
files2 <- dir(countDir,
             recursive = TRUE,
             pattern="quant.sf",
             full.names = TRUE)
# countDir <- "/Users/thomascarroll/Downloads/Rroy3/20240103_rroy/DR_Cuts//"
# files3 <- dir(countDir,
#              recursive = TRUE,
#              pattern="quant.sf",
#              full.names = TRUE)
tx2gene <- read.delim(tx2geneFile,sep=",")
files <- c(files,files2)
tximported <- tximport(files,type = "salmon",tx2gene = tx2gene,txOut = FALSE)
colData <- data.frame(Sample_Unique=gsub("_salmon","",basename(dirname(files))),
                      Group=gsub("_salmon","",basename(dirname(files))) %>% gsub("_.*","",.),
                      Batch=ifelse(grepl("Rroy3",files),"Batch3",
                                   ifelse(grepl("rroy2",files),"Batch2","Batch1")),
                      salmonCounts=files) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample_Unique")


colnames(tximported$counts) <- gsub("_salmon","",basename(dirname(files)))
colnames(tximported$abundance) <- gsub("_salmon","",basename(dirname(files)))

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(tximported,colData = colData ,design = ~Group)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  normExprs <- rlog(dds)
  normExprsBatched <- limma::removeBatchEffect(assay(normExprs),colData$Batch)

PCA and heatmap without Batch correction

#plotPCA(normExprs,intgroup="Group",ntop=10^6)

res <- prcomp(t(assay(normExprs)))
toPlot <- merge(res$x,colData,by=0)
require(ggplot2)
ggplot(toPlot,aes(x=PC1,y=PC2,colour=Group,shape=Batch))+geom_point(size=3)

# ggplot(toPlot,aes(x=PC1,y=PC2,colour=Batch))+geom_point(size=3)
require(RColorBrewer)
require(pheatmap)
sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(normExprs)))

sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- colData$Group[match(colnames(normExprs),rownames(colData))]
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- colnames(normExprs)
colors <- colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")) )(255)
# png(paste0(ComparisonName,"_sampleDist.png"))
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows=sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols=sampleDists,
         annotation_col=as.data.frame(colData) %>% dplyr::select(Group,Batch),
         col=colors)

PCA and heatmap with Batch correction

res <- prcomp(t(normExprsBatched))
toPlot <- merge(res$x,colData,by=0)
require(ggplot2)
ggplot(toPlot,aes(x=PC1,y=PC2,colour=Group,shape=Batch))+geom_point(size=3)

# ggplot(toPlot,aes(x=PC1,y=PC2,colour=Batch))+geom_point(size=3)
require(RColorBrewer)
require(pheatmap)
sampleDists <- dist(t(normExprsBatched))

sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- colData$Group[match(colnames(normExprsBatched),rownames(colData))]
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- colnames(normExprsBatched)
colors <- colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")) )(255)
# png(paste0(ComparisonName,"_sampleDist.png"))
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows=sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols=sampleDists,
         annotation_col=as.data.frame(colData) %>% dplyr::select(Group,Batch),
         col=colors) 

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(tximported,colData = colData ,design = ~Batch+Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds,contrast = c("Group","Cut","Uncut"))
res %<>% as.data.frame %>% arrange(pvalue)
require(org.Dr.eg.db)
DEtableanno <- AnnotationDbi::select(x = org.Dr.eg.db,keys = rownames(res),keytype = "ENSEMBL",columns = c("ENSEMBL","SYMBOL"))
res <- merge(DEtableanno,res,by.y=0,by.x=1,all=TRUE) %>% arrange(pvalue)
rio::export(res,file = "Cut_minus_Uncut_BatchCorrected.xlsx")
sessionInfo()
